question: Which groups are gathered together in the assembly of the mother circle?
premises: Gaṇeśas are present in the gathering.
Vaṭukas and siddhas are present in the gathering.
The gathering takes place in the mother circle assembly.
inference: Gaṇeśas, vaṭukas, and siddhas are gathered in the assembly of the mother circle.
plain_english: The gaṇeśas, vaṭukas, and siddhas were indeed gathered in the assembly of the mother circle.
